segments.text: If you've been vibe coding your way through a project and have no real idea how it actually works, codebase to course fixes that. It's a clawed code
skill that takes your entire codebase and generates a single page interactive HTML crash course from it. plain English translations, metaphors, visualizations,
and quizzes, all rendered directly in the browser using Claude's HTML artifacts.
